items.reason: Gap 0 explicitly describes overlapping retry processing where both jobs pass the set check before either inserts the event ID, causing the handler to run twice.
Gap 2 states that the deduplication key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that changing or forging it defeats deduplication.
Gap 3 identifies that the provider sends charge.refunded while the refund handler is registered as refund.created, so refunds are dropped.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas having separate in-memory state.
